subject: North Ridge billing: portal vs email onboarding + PO mapping questions
messages:
From: ProcureCo AP Team <ap@procureco.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice submission for North Ridge - onboarding & PO details

Hi Maya / Redwood team,

We're onboarding North Ridge Logistics (POs will begin this month) and need to confirm preferred invoice submission flows so we can configure our AR system. Two quick questions:

1) Do you require invoices to be submitted through the Redwood supplier portal, or will you accept emailed invoices during the initial go-live window? If email is allowed, please confirm subject token format and any mandatory headers.

2) What are the absolute minimum invoice fields you need for automated PO-stamping and matching? We have sample output available as CSV (attached). We also attached our completed vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx for your team to verify.

Attachment(s): vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx, sample_invoice.csv

Thanks — want to avoid manual handoffs once volume ramps.

Best,
ProcureCo AP Team
Alex Romero
ProcureCo | Accounts Payable
ap@procureco.com
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: ProcureCo AP Team <ap@procureco.com>, Alex Romero <alex.romero@procureco.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission for North Ridge - onboarding & PO details

Alex — thanks for the attachments and the clear questions. Short answer and then specifics: we prefer the supplier portal for production (automation + visibility). We will accept emailed invoices for a 3-week pilot window while the portal account is enabled. Details below so your tech/ops folks can implement.

Portal (preferred):
- Full automation: single invoice upload per PO (PDF or structured CSV)
- PO-stamping handled server-side, automated matching rules applied
- Required to enable in production for long-term: vendor SSO + subject token not needed

Email (pilot only):
- Allowed dates: 2026-10-04 through 2026-10-25 (portal cutover target)
- Subject must start with: NR-PO:<PO_NUMBER> (example: NR-PO:543210) — this is how our pipeline routes and stamps.
- Single PDF per email preferred; if multiple POs included, filename must clearly indicate PO numbers (e.g., NR_PO_543210_543211.pdf)

Minimum fields for automated PO-stamping/match (CSV or structured PDF metadata):
- Redwood PO number (NR-PO or PO)
- Invoice date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)
- Invoice total and currency
- Line items: quantity, unit price, SKU/description
- Supplier name + remit-to address
- Tax/VAT amount and tax ID if applicable

Edge cases and exceptions:
- Consolidated invoices covering multiple POs: acceptable, but must include a per-PO breakdown row so our matching engine can allocate amounts correctly.
- Credit notes: mark Subject as NR-CN:<PO_NUMBER> and include original invoice reference.

I'll fill in the onboarding form fields you attached and return with any missing fields flagged. Vanessa (cc'd) will own the mutual action plan and technical contact. Karthik — can you confirm whether we need a special subject token for VAT-registered economies?

Thanks,
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Procurement Integrations | Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
From: Alex Romero <alex.romero@procureco.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission for North Ridge - onboarding & PO details

Thanks Maya — a couple quick clarifications from our side as we prep the AR feed: 

1) Multiple-PO invoices: our default ERP can emit one consolidated CSV per remittance. Is the per-PO breakdown row schema you expect the same as your sample_invoice.csv (line per PO with amount allocation)? We attached sample_consolidated.csv for reference.

2) VAT handling: North Ridge is VAT-registered. For EU/UK tax reconciliation we can send tax_id and tax breakdown per line — do you need a separate tax_id field at header level or is line-level tax sufficient?

3) For the email pilot, will you accept CSV attachments or only PDFs? We prefer CSV for automated ingestion but can fall back to PDFs if required.

Attachment(s): sample_consolidated.csv

Appreciate the timeline — we'll aim to get the portal account request in today.

—Alex
ProcureCo AP
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: ProcureCo AP Team <ap@procureco.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission for North Ridge - onboarding & PO details

Hi Alex / ProcureCo team — looping with a short mutual action plan so we have shared expectations.

1) Portal activation (owner: Redwood Ops / intake): target go-live 2026-10-25. Action: ProcureCo to complete vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx and click the DocuSign link (https://docusign.example.com/NR-onboard-789) by 2026-10-11. Redwood will provision portal access and run a smoke test with a sample CSV.

2) Email pilot (owner: ProcureCo AP): 2026-10-04 — 2026-10-25. Rules while pilot active:
   - Subject token required: NR-PO:<PO_NUMBER> for each invoice email.
   - Preferred attachment: structured CSV with per-PO breakdown. PDF allowed as fallback (single PO per PDF).
   - Filename convention for consolidated files: NR_CONSOL_<YYYYMMDD>_<PO1-PO2>.csv

3) PO stamping / matching (owner: Redwood Integrations): our matcher requires either a PO header field or a per-line PO column in CSV. If consolidated, line-level PO column is mandatory. VAT/tax: include tax_id at header level if available; line-level tax breakdown is also accepted.

4) Exceptions & escalation: any unmatched invoices should be reported to ap-ops@redwood.com with the subject: NR-ESCALATE:<PO_NUMBER>. We'll triage within 24 hours SLA during pilot.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.docx (high level timeline + acceptance criteria)

If that looks good, Alex please confirm by EOD 2026-10-08 and attach the completed onboarding form. Karthik — FYI on VAT token guidance; feel free to add a note if we should require tax_id for EU/UK suppliers.

Thanks all,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
